author: Exow
body:
Hello

I originate from Pot/ Soup PvP and I want to play Avicus. You may be thinking, you must have no knowledge of Avicus. But trust me, I do. I have watched a lot of videos on OCN and Avicus and therefore I understand the game. Anyway, it is rumored that next tournament will be TDM, and I would say I am a pretty good pvper because of my experience on Pot and Soup.

I am 15 years of age.
I live in Miami.
Here is a video of me pving: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gs851bLz4lY

I can give my Skype if needed.
I have Teamspeak.
I am fine with trialing for teams.

Regards
Exow
